name: events-busy-day
screenshotStyleReason: The street's rain falls across the posters, the column and the pager; each side draws it its own way (the app as pictures within EV2a's agreed budget, the mock as live SVG; compared in events-sky), so it is hidden only while these elements are shot, as is each side's floating Composer button.

pairs.name: Ended stack
pairs.reason: The posters on the wall are each side's own drawing (the app's poster pictures, the mock's live SVG, as in events-wall); the bay's box, place and width are compared.

pairs.name: Ended tag
pairs.reason: The tag's words anti-alias a little differently on each side (up to 1.2% of its pixels); its box and styles are compared exactly.

pairs.reason: The tag's words anti-alias a little differently on each side (up to 1.2% of its pixels); its box and styles are compared exactly.

note: The sample day has two events (18:30, 20:00), so at 19:30 it folds into an Ended stack beside the 20:00 hour; Later and the all-ended card need a busier day than the sample has, and are checked in the browser. A stack's count shows only when it holds more than its one poster (the mock's hasMore), so the sample's one ended event has none.
